performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may prove only a local generated class inventory, isolated jar and namespace dependency closure for four frozen Java sources. It cannot prove a persistent Maven profile, CLI, PackageOnly archive, deployment, server enforcement, source registration, first future evidence, prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any future drawdown reduction remains MISSING_PROOF until lawful prospective carry evidence supports a separately preregistered matched-capital Validation and sealed OOS result.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One bounded local compile consumes small CPU and time but prevents a broader PackageOnly implementation from shipping hidden Spring, Trading or unrelated research classes; failure closes the package path before server or future-data capacity is consumed.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Exact class closure cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly, but it removes one implementation uncertainty on the shortest path to a credible accept-or-reject test of the carry-conditioned DRA mechanism while preserving evidence integrity.
